ledger.claim: The rider did everything a waiting passenger is asked to do. At 06:24:40 she sent 'I'm at the private-hire bay, where are you?' — a message that states her own position at the pickup bay and asks for the driver's, which is exactly the locating-or-coordinating content POL-NS-04(a) requires. The driver's first and only chat entry came at 06:29:40, 300 seconds later, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so the driver neither replied within 120 seconds of that message nor placed an in-app call at any point before terminating the trip. Limbs (a) and (b) of POL-NS-04 are satisfied on the record; the rider repeated herself at 06:26:40 and 06:28:40 and the first two messages went unanswered for 300 and 180 seconds respectively.

Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is satisfied on the rider's own track. Her device produced 54 qualifying fixes between 06:23:40 and 06:31:37, every one of them inside the 200 m rider_presence_radius_m fixed for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup — the closest fix was 9.31 m from the pin and the furthest 19.53 m, with a mean of 14.26 m and a single reported speed of 0.0 km/h. That is not merely the majority of qualifying fixes across the waiting window; it is all of them, and the rider was stationary throughout.

The driver never arrived, and his own trace proves it. Across 67 fixes spanning 06:20:40 to 06:31:40 the closest he came to the pickup pin was 1,412.66 m, with a mean distance of 1,734.22 m; the derived qualifying_fix_count inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius is 0. POL-NS-02 deems arrival only where the trace holds at least 3 consecutive fixes within that radius, and there is not one. POL-NS-01 limb (b) therefore fails and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

Two more of POL-NS-01's four conjunctive limbs fail. Limb (a) requires a driver 'arrived' event in the trip record, and trip_record.arrived_at is null — the derived arrival block reports the same null against EV-TRIP-00623. Limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 300 seconds for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix; the longest qualifying run is 0.0 seconds across 0 fixes, so the dwell is zero against a 300-second minimum. Because POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and the driver side must carry every limb, the failure of (a) and (c) alone is dispositive: the fee is not chargeable under this clause.

The waiting-period arithmetic is as short as it can be. The measured in-geofence dwell is 0.0 seconds against the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, a shortfall of exactly 300.0 seconds. POL-NS-06 limb (i) cannot rescue the driver here for two independent reasons: the trace shows 0 in-geofence intervals, so there is no second interval to accumulate, and accumulation would in any event require a present and populated traffic_advisory of a covered type (KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT) over the pickup road. EV-ADVIS-00623-01 is MISSING — I cite that absence, its issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and its weight of 0.0, and no fact rests on it: no advisory covers this road, so nothing licenses summing intervals. POL-NS-06 entitles the rider to a full refund of the cancellation-fee line.

The wrong-entrance route under POL-NS-03 cannot rescue the fee either, so the driver's best fallback is closed. POL-NS-03 requires the driver to have been stationary for the required dwell at a point outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pin; the closest fix of the entire trip was 1,412.66 m out, and the track shows the driver moving at speeds up to 46.3 km/h. He was neither at the wrong face of the interchange nor stationary anywhere near it. In any event the rider named her position in chat — 'I'm at the private-hire bay' at 06:24:40 — which under POL-NS-03 limb (i) would place the loss on the driver and remove compensation entirely.

POL-NS-05 addresses the substance of this trip even though no 'arrived' marker was ever tapped (arrived_at is null). Limb (ii) provides that where no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, the fee is refunded in full, no compensation is payable, and the trip is recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver in the ruling's referrals list. That is precisely this trace: qualifying_fix_count 0, the driver's last fix at 06:31:40 — the moment of cancellation — still at least 1,412.66 m from the pin and travelling at up to 46.3 km/h. The rider asks that the false-arrival referral be recorded.

The chat sequence and the driver's own statement explain this cancellation. His single contribution to the thread was 'can add $10 thank you fee?' at 06:29:40 — sent after three unanswered rider messages and not a word about his position; the rider answered 'no' at 06:30:10; he cancelled as RIDER_NO_SHOW at 06:31:40, ninety seconds after being refused. In his own statement he says 'I couldn't see her at the pickup so I cancelled' — an admission of failure to locate, which POL-NS-01 states does not satisfy limb (d) and sends the case to POL-NS-03. Nothing in the record shows the rider absent: her device sat 9 to 20 m from the pin for the entire window.

On quantum the ledger charges exactly one cancellation fee of SGD 6.00, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so a full refund returns the whole contested SGD 6.00 and nothing is left behind. The figure reconciles with the schedule: the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee is SGD 6.00 against a RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of SGD 4.00, and the greater governs at SGD 6.00, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and no amount to trim. Under POL-GEN-03 a FULL_REFUND returns the whole contested amount to the filing party, who is the rider.

No compensation is payable to the driver. POL-NS-07 compensates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; here POL-NS-01 fails on limbs (a), (b) and (c) and both POL-NS-04 and POL-NS-06 displace it, so there is no fee and therefore no 80 percent share of one. For completeness the anti-farming counters do not bite either: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4 that POL-NS-07 sets, so no compensation question arises on any view.

Nothing on this record requires escalation, and none of POL-NS-09's triggers fires: the counterparty counters are 0 and 0, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is untripped, and no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence — the trip record, the driver's trace and the chat log are unanimous that he was never at the pin. The four artifacts I rely on are all COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with no issue codes: the trace has no sampling gap (gaps empty, max_gap_sec 0.0), the chat holds 5 messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count, and the fare reconciles, so no limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08 is engaged and POL-GEN-02's confidence cap on the deciding facts is 1.0, well clear of the 0.70 floor. The one artifact that is not clean is EV-ADVIS-00623-01: MISSING, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0 — I cite its absence only, no fact rests on it, and it decides nothing here. Escalation would hold the fee rather than return it; the record supports the refund.

The cancellation reason code is not in issue. The trip record shows the driver terminated the trip at 06:31:40 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) expressly recognises, and the record contains no boarding event and no completed leg. The driver did not cancel under a driver-fault code such as DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, so limb (d) of the baseline test is satisfied and the driver's reporting of the termination is within what the policy anticipates.

The SGD 6.00 on the ledger is the scheduled amount, not an invented one. For a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup the zone-class fee is SGD 6.00 and for RYDE_X the vehicle-tier fee is SGD 4.00; fee_schedule.resolution_rule takes the GREATER of the two, which is SGD 6.00, and the fare breakdown computes a fee_charged of SGD 6.00 with a difference of SGD 0.00 against the schedule and a cancellation_fee line of SGD 6.00. POL-NS-08(d) is therefore not engaged: there is no fare-integrity defect available to the rider on the amount charged.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip on this driver. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 and driver_profile.completed_trips_30d is 110, a ratio of approximately 0.009. The check requires BOTH limbs - a trailing-30-day count of 4 or more AND a ratio above 0.08 - and neither is met. Nothing in POL-NS-07 permits this driver to be characterised as harvesting no-show fees, and no payment may be withheld or case escalated on that footing.

No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is made out on the profile counters. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so limb (c)'s two-or-more-disputes-between-the-same-pair test fails, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so limb (d)'s abuse indicator fails. This is a single-trip dispute and the record carries no pattern evidence against this driver that would justify declining to decide it on its merits.

POL-NS-04(b) is not made out. The rider's final coordinating message, 'are you coming', was sent at 06:28:40, and the driver posted a reply in the chat log at 06:29:40 - 60 seconds later, inside the 120-second window limb (b) allows. Limb (b) asks only whether a reply was posted within 120 seconds, and the clause's own commentary confirms that where the driver did so reply the clause does not apply regardless of the content of the reply. The rider-exoneration route under POL-NS-04 is therefore not established as to that message.

POL-NS-05 is not engaged, and no false-arrival record should be entered against this driver. That clause operates on a false 'arrived' marker - an arrival event whose timestamp the trace contradicts. The trip record carries no arrival event at all (arrived_at is null), and the trace-derived arrival block was computed as a waiting-period shortfall (longest_run_sec 0 against a shortfall_sec of 300) rather than as a false marker, so there is no marker to impugn and the timing question falls to be decided on the trace directly under POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-06.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 6.00 no-show cancellation fee cannot stand, and the rider is refunded the full SGD 6.00.

The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-00623, weight 1.0) runs 67 fixes from 06:20:40 to 06:31:40, and not one of them falls inside the 150 m arrival radius for this TRANSPORT_HUB pickup (Bedok Bus Interchange private-hire bay): the closest fix is 1,412.66 m from the pin, the mean is 1,734.22 m, and at the moment of cancellation (06:31:40) he is still over 1.4 km out, moving at up to 46.3 km/h. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00623, weight 1.0) shows arrived_at is null - no arrival event was ever recorded. By contrast the rider's device (same trace) sat 9.31 m to 19.53 m from the pin across 54 qualifying fixes from 06:23:40 to 06:31:37, stationary at 0.0 km/h, and the chat (EV-CHAT-00623) shows she messaged 'I'm at the private-hire bay, where are you?' at 06:24:40, 'hello?' at 06:26:40 and 'are you coming' at 06:28:40.

POL-NS-01 needs all four conditions before a no-show fee is chargeable. Limb (a) fails (no 'arrived' event), limb (b) fails (no qualifying in-geofence fix), and limb (c) fails (longest continuous in-geofence dwell 0.0 s against the 300 s TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, of which the derived block records a shortfall of 300.0 s). Only limb (d) is met - the record does terminate the trip with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes the clause recognises - and because the clause is conjunctive that single limb cannot carry the fee.

Three clauses give the rider the full SGD 6.00 independently. POL-NS-02: no qualifying in-radius fix exists at any point in the 15 minutes before cancellation, so the driver never arrived. POL-NS-06: effective in-geofence dwell 0.0 s against a 300 s minimum, and the limb (i) accumulation route is unavailable - the trace shows 0 in-geofence intervals, and EV-ADVIS-00623-01 (traffic advisory) is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0), a citable absence on which no fact rests. POL-NS-04: the rider sent a locating/coordinating message at 06:24:40, the driver posted no reply within 120 s and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, and the rider stayed inside the 200 m presence radius on all 54 qualifying fixes.

On the driver's surviving points: I accept that limb (d) is satisfied on the recorded RIDER_NO_SHOW code, that the SGD 6.00 reconciles with the fee schedule (the GREATER of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone fee SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_X tier fee SGD 4.00, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged), that the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d is 1 and the ratio is about 0.009, against thresholds of 4 and 0.08), and that no POL-NS-09 profile trigger fires. But none of that supplies limbs (a) to (c). His point that POL-NS-04(b) is defeated because he answered the rider's 06:28:40 nudge 60 s later with 'can add $10 thank you fee?' is rejected: limb (b) runs from the rider's locating message, and her 06:24:40 locating message went unanswered for 300 s with no call placed; in any event POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 reach the same full refund on their own.

His point that POL-NS-05 does not fire is accepted, and the rider's contrary request is declined: POL-NS-05 operates on a false 'arrived' marker, and no marker was ever tapped (arrived_at is null), so there is no false-arrival event to record and no referral is produced. The driver's statement that he 'couldn't see her at the pickup' is treated as an admission of failure to locate, which under POL-NS-01 does not satisfy limb (d); the rider was demonstrably at the pin.

No driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not. POL-NS-03 gives nothing: the driver was never stationary anywhere within its 400 m ceiling (closest fix 1,412.66 m, and moving), and in any case the rider named her location in chat at 06:24:40, which would place the loss on the driver.

No escalation is warranted. No limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08 touches a deciding artifact (the trace has no sampling gap, max_gap_sec 0.0; the chat holds 5 messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count; the fare reconciles; no arrival event exists to suffer clock skew), the profile counters are 0 and 0 with no_show_disputes_30d 0, the anti-farming check is untripped, and no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence. Confidence is capped at 1.0, every deciding artifact carrying weight 1.0, and is stated at 0.95, above the 0.70 floor. The ledger's SGD 6.00 (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is returned in full to the rider.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
